recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is recommended for FHIR-5227 unless the work group later requests a broader editorial rewrite of the developer overview.
issue_request: FHIR-5227 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 ballot comment asking the FHIR-core developer overview to make the Transaction interaction clearer because the old row showed only a POST URL and did not say how the submitted transaction content was specified.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit 03375e61e1734eb1dea95a3a2557ceba68d78e34, the git-svn mirror of svn revision 4510 cited in Jira. That commit added a parenthetical to source/overview-dev.html saying to POST a transaction bundle to the system; later commits corrected the typo and normalized example URLs while preserving the clarification.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists overview-dev.html as the Developer Introduction, confirming the page is current build input. The current overview distinguishes Create at /base/{resourceType} from Transaction at /base/ and the detailed REST page states that transaction POST content is a Bundle with Bundle.type batch or transaction. Jira exact-wording search found only FHIR-5227, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already resolves the original ambiguity, so changing source would only duplicate or churn correct wording.
